Pay subsidy

A pay subsidy is financial support that an employer can get for hiring an unemployed jobseeker.

Amount

In most cases the subsidy is a share of the pay costs of the person hired.

  • First list item about eligibility rules for the subsidy.

  • Nested paragraph item.

When to apply

The employer must apply before the employment relationship starts, so apply well in advance.
